title: Open Channels FM: Your Website Could Use a Changelog to Fuel Creativity
summary: A website changelog helps creators document progress, celebrate small wins, showcase evolution, fuel creativity, and build audience trust. It can include updates, humor, and various formats, making it accessible for all.
